description:
Gastown is a small colony game set in Vancouver. Command a crew of colonists, gather food and materials, and build a town between Burrard Inlet and False Creek.

Your colonists only do what you tell them. Point them at a node and they keep gathering until you call them off. Machines do the rest: generators make power, drills sit on nodes and mine on their own, and shelters make room for new recruits who join each day.

The goal is one thing: raise the Gastown Steam Clock. Stock enough materials and power, build it, and you win.

Three resources. Four buildings. No idle timers, no ads, no autoplay.
promotionalText: Command your crew, build machines that run themselves, and raise the Steam Clock over Vancouver.
whatsNew: NYC Survive is now Gastown, and it is a new game. The city is Vancouver, the rules are simpler, and the goal is the Steam Clock: three resources, four buildings, colonists that follow your orders and machines that work on their own. Saves from 1.x do not carry over.
